manual_pages_to_read.name: manual_pages_to_read
manual_pages_to_read.where: "manual_pages"."ocr_at" is null and octet_length("manual_pages"."text") < 64 and length("manual_pages"."search_vector") = 0

stock_units_texts.name: stock_units_texts
stock_units_texts.value: length("stock_units"."model_number") between 1 and 20 and length("stock_units"."description") between 1 and 120 and length("stock_units"."engine_number") between 1 and 30 and length("stock_units"."notes") between 1 and 1000

stock_units_invoice.name: stock_units_invoice
stock_units_invoice.value: length("stock_units"."invoice_number") between 1 and 20 and length("stock_units"."file_name") between 1 and 200
